messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 pager - kv-store-read-latency: multiple prim/sec p99s > 3s across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Triggered at 2024-11-18T01:02:00Z. Paging oncall.
Priya Rao: I'm on it. hopping in — taking primary for the next 4h. Marco, can you stay secondary until 06:00 UTC? :hand:
Marco Li: yep I can cover secondary until 06:00 UTC. quick context: we saw a regen spike ~00:50 UTC that coincided with a batch job hitting large seq lengths.
Jen Ortiz: re: customer impact — Sentry shows a rise in 502s for embeddings endpoints; estimated ~3% of requests failing in eu-west-1. Not seeing data exfil or auth issues. logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/kv/494321 — sample attached.
Kofi Mensah: adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/shifts/runbooks/kv-read-degradation. TL;DR: check prim/sec CPU compaction, node-local disk IO, and eviction rate. If eviction > 500/s consider raising cache TTL for prefetch jobs.
Priya Rao: quick checklist I'm running now:
- kubectl -n inference-kv get pods -l role=primary (check pod restarts)
- curl /metrics on primaries for io_wait, swap (watching iowait spike)
- scale up cache-workers by 1 (temp)
- apply read-only fallback for embeddings route if p50>500ms

Marco Li: I'm running logs tail:
```
kubectl -n inference-kv logs -l role=primary --since=10m | grep -E "evict|oom|iowait"
```
seeing a flurry of "evict key=... ttl_expired" and a handful of slow disk reads.

Jen Ortiz: Customers flagged: AcmeAI (high priority) and internal smoke tests. Not yet escalated to sales. Posting customer note in #customer-impact after we confirm containment.
Priya Rao: mitigation in progress:
1) increased primaries from 4 -> 6 in us-west-2 (scaled via infra-runbook auto-scale script)
2) temporarily set embeddings route to read-only fallback for eu-west-1 (redirects to cached variant)
3) throttled heavy background batch job (job-id 20241118-0049) to reduce cache churn

ops-bot: autoscale event: scaled group inference-kv-primaries-usw2 from 4 to 6. Time=2024-11-18T01:12:10Z.
Kofi Mensah: note — evictions dropped ~60% after throttling job. p99 read latency in eu-west-1 dropped from 3.6s -> 1.8s over 4 minutes.
Marco Li: still seeing sporadic 502s from one prim node (pod inference-kv-prim-3). it has a non-zero restart count. I recommend cordoning and draining that pod for postmortem.
Priya Rao: agreed. Marco, can you cordon & drain? Command:
```
kubectl -n inference-kv cordon inference-kv-prim-3
kubectl -n inference-kv drain inference-kv-prim-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

Marco Li: cordoned and draining now. Pod terminated and replaced. New pod started healthy.
Jen Ortiz: customer note ready draft: "We've detected transient read latency affecting embeddings in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Mitigations applied; most traffic now normal. We'll follow up with RCA." I'll post once Priya confirms containment. :memo:
Priya Rao: containment: YES. p99s stabilized below 1.2s in both regions. no active pages. leaving read-only fallback in place for eu-west-1 for 30m as buffer. handing off shift at 05:45 UTC to Kofi.
Kofi Mensah: I'll be primary from 05:45-09:45 UTC. details noted. items for next shift:
- follow up pod replacement postmortem for inference-kv-prim-3
- confirm batch-job rate limits are persisted
- validate cache TTL change didn't regress embed quality metrics

Priya Rao: handoff done. summary for bridge: active alerts cleared, mitigations: scale-up, throttle batch job, cordon/replace problematic pod, read-only fallback (temp). Customer impact: ~3% drops for embeddings, mostly transient; AcmeAI ticket opened and update queued.
incident-bot: Incident SEV2 -> MONITORING. Closed at 2024-11-18T01:40:00Z per oncall confirmation.
Marco Li: added follow-up todos in runbook page. tagging SRE postmortem board. :white_check_mark:
Jen Ortiz: I'll send the customer note and close the support loop. Good handoff everyone. :bow:
Kofi Mensah: acknowledged. taking over. Ping me in thread for any regressions."
